From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Redwood POC kickoff & next steps

Hi Asha —

Thanks for the great discovery session today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before the POC kicks off: 

Summary from today
- Goal: validate 30% cost reduction vs current embedding pipeline and achieve <150ms median inference latency for top user flows.
- Scope: 2 models (embedding + chat), ingest ~500k docs, sample user queries from BrightWave Prod.

Proposed next steps
1) I’ll send the POC checklist + kickoff agenda (attached). Please confirm the platform access we discussed and the two engineers who will own setup.
2) Kickoff call — proposed Mon 23 Feb, 10am PT (30m). If that works, we’ll invite Stephanie from Customer Success to help with onboarding.
3) SOW: we’ll draft a one-page statement of work and the measurement plan after kickoff.

Risks/ blockers
- Access to S3 bucket + sample queries — required for day 1.
- Clear success metrics (cost delta and latency) — we can finalize on kickoff.

Attachments: POC-checklist.pdf, POC-kickoff-agenda.docx

Happy to shift timing if you prefer a different cadence.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole

Date: Mon, 23 Feb 2026 07:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood POC kickoff & next steps

Asha —

Thanks — invite sent for 10am PT. Quick follow-up on S3 access: our security-approved pattern is an IAM role ARN that allows GetObject/ListBucket on the POC prefix; if your team prefers, a short-term pre-signed URL approach for the initial dataset also works. I pasted the minimal policy here for your security team to review: 

---
Action: s3:GetObject, s3:ListBucket
Resource: arn:aws:s3:::brightwave-poc/*
Effect: Allow
---

If Ravi or Dana want to loop in a security contact, happy to include ours for an hour to unblock.

See you on the call. Stephanie will run the onboarding and help with access once we have the role/URL.

Thanks,
Marissa
